actions.name: List my repositories
actions.description: Lists the repositories you can reach, most recently changed first, 100 a page: each one's owner/name (which the other GitHub actions take), whether it is private or archived, its default branch, whether you can push to it and its description.

page.description: The page to read, from 1; the first page when left out.

actions.name: Find issues and pull requests
actions.description: Searches issues, or pull requests, in one repository or among those that involve you, 25 a page. Your words are searched as words: they never become search qualifiers. Give a repository, an involvement, or both.

type.description: issue or pull-request: one search finds one kind.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

involvement.description: Only items that involve you this way.

text.description: Words every item found holds, at most 256 characters.

page.description: The page to read, from 1; the first page when left out.

actions.name: Read conversation
actions.description: Reads one issue or pull request and its comments, oldest first, 50 a page: title, state, author, labels and body (cut at 8,000 characters), each comment (cut at 4,000, ending in [truncated] when cut), and for a pull request its branches, head commit and whether it is merged.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

number.description: The issue or pull request number.

page.description: The page to read, from 1; the first page when left out.

actions.name: Create issue
actions.description: Opens one issue with a title, and a body and up to 10 labels when given. GitHub notifies everyone the body @mentions; the card lists them.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

labels.description: Label names; GitHub creates one the repository lacks.

preview.label: Labels to add (GitHub creates any the repository lacks)

actions.name: Update, close or reopen issue
actions.description: Changes the title or body of one issue, or closes or reopens it, sending only what you give. Close as says why it closed: completed or not_planned. A pull request number works too.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

number.description: The issue or pull request number.

closeAs.description: Why it closed, with state closed.

actions.name: Add or remove labels
actions.description: Adds and removes labels on one issue or pull request, one request per label, so an empty list is never sent (it would remove every label). Removing a label it does not have changes nothing.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

number.description: The issue or pull request number.

add.description: Label names to add, up to 10; [] for none.

remove.description: Label names to remove, up to 10; [] for none. A name holding / or % cannot be removed this way.

preview.label: Labels to add (GitHub creates any the repository lacks)

actions.name: Comment
actions.description: Comments on one issue or pull request. GitHub notifies everyone the comment @mentions, and everyone who follows the conversation; the card lists the mentions.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

number.description: The issue or pull request number.

actions.name: Read a file
actions.description: Reads one file of a repository as text, on a branch or the default branch, cut at 200,000 characters. A file that is not text reads as binary. A folder, a link or a file over 1 MB is refused.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

path.description: The file's path in the repository, such as docs/notes.md, with no leading slash.

ref.description: The branch to read; the default branch when left out.

actions.name: Create or update a file
actions.description: Writes one text file on a branch as one commit: a new file, or a new version of the one read first. If the file changed after it was read, nothing is written. A file under .github/workflows/ needs the workflow permission, since it runs in GitHub Actions.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

path.description: The file's path in the repository, such as docs/notes.md, with no leading slash.

branch.description: A branch name, such as main or fabric/notes.

content.description: The whole new text of the file, at most 750,000 bytes as UTF-8.

actions.name: Create a branch
actions.description: Makes a new branch at the commit another branch points to now. The card shows that commit.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

name.description: The new branch's name, such as fabric/notes.

from.description: The branch it starts from, such as main.

actions.name: Open a pull request
actions.description: Opens a pull request from a branch into another branch of the same repository, as a draft or ready for review. GitHub notifies everyone the body @mentions; the card lists them.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

base.description: The branch to merge them into, such as main.

draft.description: true opens it as a draft, which cannot be merged until it is marked ready.

actions.name: Review changes and checks
actions.description: Reads one pull request to review it: its state, branches, head commit, whether GitHub can merge it, its changed files 50 a page (each patch cut at 3,000 characters, ending in [truncated] when cut) and the check runs on its head commit.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

page.description: The page of changed files, from 1; the first page when left out.

actions.name: Submit a review
actions.description: Submits a review of one open pull request, pinned to the head commit read first: APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES (needs a body) or COMMENT (needs a body). GitHub notifies the author and everyone the body @mentions.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

actions.name: Merge
actions.description: Merges one open pull request, only if its head is still the commit read first and shown on the card; if anyone pushed since, nothing is merged. A draft cannot be merged.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

method.description: merge keeps every commit, squash makes one, rebase replays them.

actions.name: Run a workflow
actions.description: Starts one GitHub Actions workflow that can be run by hand, on a branch, with its inputs as text. The run shows in the workflow's runs a moment later.

repository.description: The repository, as owner/name, such as octo-org/platform.

workflow.description: The workflow's file name, such as ci.yml, or its id.

branch.description: A branch name, such as main or fabric/notes.

inputs.description: The workflow's inputs as name and text value; [] for none.
